headline: Recommends a contract of just over $460,000 to replace the car wash system at the QTA facility.
summary: Scott Barker, the city's chief innovation officer, presented the city's new artificial intelligence policy and took questions. Staff then gave updates on a September 12 emergency exercise, a 5K run, airport construction, sound insulation, electric vehicle charging, and fuel taxes.
decisions: Approved the Consent Agenda, with no opposition heard.
Recommended a contract with Maintenance Tech, Incorporated, just over $460,000, to replace the car wash system at the QTA facility, for approval by the Board of Finance and City Council.
discussion: Artificial intelligence use: Members asked how the city policy affects airport work. Scott Barker said the policy is a living document that will be updated, and that other tools may be used when Copilot is not enough.
Electric vehicle charging: Members discussed the six public chargers in the parking garage. Concerns included gas cars parked in charging spots and whether drivers should pay for electricity.

Late-night arrival delays: A complaint about waits for gates, luggage, and garage exit led to questions about tracking data. Staff said early arrivals and limited airline staffing have caused some delays.

Sound insulation phases: Members asked how many homes could qualify and how long the program would run. Staff said about 2,400 units are within the noise exposure contour, and the program may run for years.

Fuel tax collection: Staff plans to send South Burlington a letter asking that its 1% sales tax on aviation fuel be returned to the airport. Staff said those funds were in excess of $1 million in fiscal year 2025.

decision_evidence.quote: You hear the motion to approve the contents of the Consent Agenda? ... Opposed? The ayes have it.

Maintenance Tech, Incorporated for the replacement of the vehicle wash system in the QTA facility. ... All right. Motions, all those in favor approve of passage of this action item, please signify by saying, aye. Aye. Aye. All right. Any opposed?
